tutorial.anyone_recovering_from_a_punch: Anyone recovering from a punch, especially a miss, is Vulnerable and pulses red-orange. The dummy will whiff: step in and hit it while it recovers.
tutorial.cross_text: Cross: slower but heavier, and the longest reach (about 20% more than the jab). {btn} to land 2 crosses.
tutorial.dodge_text: {btn} to slip punches. The stick picks the direction; no direction = step back. Avoid 2 punches.
tutorial.everything_is_on_knock_the: Everything is on. Knock the dummy out!
tutorial.green_is_health_hits_that: Green is health. Hits that reach the FACE (inner circle) do full damage and cost the defender stamina; body hits do half damage and no stamina loss. Land one face hit and one body hit (from max range).
tutorial.guard_text: The dummy attacks now. Hold {btn} to block 3 jabs. Blocking costs stamina, never health.
tutorial.hit_someone_while_they_are: Hit someone while they are STARTING a punch, or right after they drop guard or dodge = COUNTER (x1.5 damage). The dummy throws slow crosses: beat one with a Cross or Hook.
tutorial.hook_text: Hook: a heavy swing with a shorter reach than the jab. Close in and {btn} to land a hook.
tutorial.jab_text: Jab: your fastest, lightest punch. {btn} to land 2 jabs.
tutorial.perfect_guard_text: Every guard raise opens a tight {perfect}-frame PERFECT GUARD window. Release exposes you for {penalty} frames and locks guard; time the next raise after that.
tutorial.repeating_one_punch_tires_it: Repeating one punch tires it: red bars fill, it gets slower and weaker ("tired"). Mix it up! Throw the same punch until 2 bars light up.
tutorial.right_after_a_dodge_you: Right after a dodge you glow yellow: your next punch does 1.5x damage. Dodge toward the dummy and punch straight away for a POWER! hit.
tutorial.taking_hits_fills_the_stun: Taking hits fills the stun meter (thin bar). Full = stunned: open to anything. The dummy is nearly there. Finish it!
tutorial.the_blue_bar_is_stamina: The blue bar is stamina. Punches, dodges and guarding spend it. At 0, emergency recovery fills the red bar at standing-still speed. All hits are headshots; punches are free but deal half damage. Guard and dodge are disabled until full. Punch until it is below half.
tutorial.your_fist_travels_out_too: Your fist travels out. Too close = SOUR (weak). At full extension = SWEET. Step back a little and land a SWEET hit.

layouts.touch_help: Drag the gold handles. Jab / Cross move together; the left joystick still floats.
layouts.keyboard_help: Select an action, then press a physical key. Escape cancels capture.
layouts.pad_help: Select an action, then press a button or choose below. Left stick moves; Start / Back cancel capture.
layouts.pad_choices: Xbox buttons (pointer choices work without a connected controller)
layouts.select_action: Select an action above before choosing a button.
layouts.capture: Binding {action}: press a key / button. Escape or Cancel stops capture.
layouts.duplicate: Already bound to another action. Choose a different key / button.
layouts.reserved: That key is reserved or unsupported. Choose another; Escape cancels.
layouts.keyboard_reserved: Escape and Enter remain menu keys. Letters, arrows, numpad and modifiers are supported.
layouts.touch_invalid: Leave space between controls for smaller screens and stay below the HUD. Move a handle or Reset before Save.
